front: What major legal change did King Henry II want across all of his lands?
back: He wanted one single set of royal laws to apply everywhere.

front: How did King Henry II make sure royal laws were applied throughout England?
back: He appointed traveling judges to go from town to town hearing cases.

back: They served on juries to help decide what happened in a case.

front: What were England's laws like before Henry II?
back: There were laws, but they were different from place to place.

front: Which church leader had a major disagreement with King Henry II?
What did Henry II and Thomas Becket argue about?
back: Whether churchmen should be judged in the king's courts.

front: Did King Henry II make the very first laws in England?

front: Why did Henry II want the same laws everywhere?
